properties.source: Over the Gulf of Guinea: streamline of the August surface wind in the NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree monthly long-term mean 1971-2000 (public domain), traced by script and simplified. Over land it is schematic: south-westerly inflow ending short of the August Intertropical Front at about 19-20 N (NOAA CPC climatology), i.e. across the Sahel.
refs: NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree enhanced monthly LTM 1971-2000, ERDDAP esrlIcoads2gec71 (accessed 2026-10-12)
